create_matmul_dataset: create a MatmulDataset instance to generate targeted size matmul benchmark programs
generate_benchmark_from_size: generate a MatmulBenchmark from an MNK size tuple using benchmark_from_size
create_matmul_benchmark: create a MatmulBenchmark from URI, bitcode bytes, and source bytes using the create class method
list_benchmark_uris: list all available matmul benchmark URIs using the benchmark_uris method on MatmulDataset
get_benchmark_by_uri: get a MatmulBenchmark instance by its URI string using the benchmark method
